crossRefs.note: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of Yahweh, which he will work for you…
You will not need to fight this battle. Set yourselves, stand still, and see the salvation of Yahweh with you, O Judah…
Moses brought their cause before Yahweh.
The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn…
Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.
“Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them…
If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I am speaking from…
for the words which you have given me I have given to them, and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from…
for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.
For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.
For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was…
Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be…
but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of…

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses answered them, “Wait, that I may hear what Yahweh will command concerning you.”
translations.bsb: “Wait here until I find out what the LORD commands concerning you,” Moses replied.
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the LORD will command
translations.asv: And Moses said unto them, Stay ye, that I may hear what Jehovah will command concerning you.
